evidence_spans.snippet: The I²C bus has a maximum speed of 400 kbits/s and uses a default device address of 0x52.
If the least significant bit is low (that is, 0x52) the message is a controller write-to-the-target. If the LSB is set (that is, 0x53) then the message is a controller read-from-the-target.
The I²C read/writes can be 8, 16, or 32-bit.
Multibyte read/writes are always addressed in ascending order with the MSB first as shown in the following table.
The actual range measurement takes 23 ms (see Figure 9. Typical initialization/ranging/housekeeping phases).
The minimum range measurement period is 8 ms.
The user can get the final data using a polling or an interrupt mechanism.
The user has to check the status of the ongoing measurement by polling an API function.
An interrupt pin (GPIO1) sends an interrupt to the host when a new measurement is available.
There are no power supply sequencing requirements.
